title: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas
steps: Combine the pulled-chicken ingredients, bring to a boil and simmer on low for 30 minutes, skimming occasionally. Remove from heat; discard onion, garlic and peppercorns. Reserve the broth, cool the chicken slightly and shred.
Mix 2 cups pulled chicken with cheese and diced onion.
Broil tomatillos on a foil-lined sheet for 4 minutes per side.
For the sour cream sauce, melt butter in a large nonstick pan over medium heat. Sauté the peppers for 3–4 minutes, then garlic for 1 minute. Add flour and cook 1 minute, stirring.
Add 2 cups reserved broth, whisking constantly until thickened. Remove from heat; blend with sour cream, cumin and cilantro. The source does not say when to add the broiled tomatillos.
For the red sauce, mix the red sauce ingredients and simmer over medium heat for 20 minutes. The source does not say how to use this sauce in assembly.
Heat oil over medium heat. Dip each tortilla for a few seconds per side to soften; drain on paper towels.

Pour 1 cup sour cream sauce into a 9 × 13-inch baking dish. Dip each tortilla in remaining sauce, fill with ⅓ cup chicken mixture, roll and place seam-side down. The source lists 14 tortillas but calls for assembling 12 enchiladas.
Pour remaining sauce over the enchiladas. Bake at 350°F for 35 minutes or until bubbly.
reviewFlags: The source omits when the broiled tomatillos are added and how the red sauce is used; it lists 14 tortillas but calls for 12 enchiladas. Confirm these details before cooking.
